_note: Design doc section 8.5. visibility: public, hidden (teaser until the first step, then hint_revealed), secret (invisible until done). Steps complete in order unless ordered is false. Step fields: event (duel_won, run_won), main, starter, node, act, act_min, opponent, allies_all, blocks_max, aspect_min, or achievement. Rewards: cards, starter. group sets the journal heading; it defaults to character.

achievements.title: The line holds
achievements.hint: As Sir Edric Rooke, win a duel with Dame Alder Rooke and Emrys Rooke both in play at the end.

achievements.title: The Vale test
achievements.hint: Beat Caedan Vale, the act 2 boss of a Crushing Depths run.

achievements.title: Fire in the knight
achievements.teaser: Edric has a score to settle.
achievements.hint_revealed: As Sir Edric Rooke, beat Bram Ashmark again in act 2 or later, standing at Aspect 3 or higher.

achievements.title: The crest comes off
achievements.teaser: Mourne holds a grudge against a man who kneels.
achievements.hint_revealed: As Gideon Mourne, beat Sir Edric Rooke again in act 2 or later.

achievements.title: The Draik offer
achievements.hint: Beat Sable Draik, the act 2 boss of a Mercenary Lord run.

achievements.title: Head-on
achievements.hint: As Bram Ashmark, beat Siphon, the act 1 boss, without playing a block.

achievements.title: The hero falls
achievements.hint: Beat Sir Edric Rooke, the act 2 boss of a Wildfire Rush run.

achievements.title: The Lodestone Heart
achievements.hint: Beat Halden Quarr at the end of a run with each of Edric, Mourne and Ashmark.

achievements.title: Unbroken
achievements.hint: Holding the Heart, finish one more run.
